# DeepResValue — Full Documentation

# DeepResValue

> DeepResValue (深度研值) — AI Research Assistant Agent SaaS for all academic disciplines. 100+ professional research skills, four compute kernels (Python, R, MATLAB/Octave, SPICE-ngspice), Word + LaTeX typesetting, MCP connectors, BYOK model support. Covers frontier methods including spatial econometrics (SAR/SEM/SDM), advanced econometrics (GMM/DID/IV/RDD), bioinformatics (genomics/transcriptomics/proteomics), CAD/engineering analysis, Bayesian statistics (MCMC/Stan/PyMC), machine learning & AI (deep learning/NLP/SHAP), structural equation modeling (SEM/CFA/IRT), epidemiology (meta-analysis/PSM/competing risks). Supports national competition scenarios: Mathematical Modeling (CUMCM/MCM-ICM), Challenge Cup, Innovation & Entrepreneurship. Single Chinese sentence drives the full research workflow with full traceability. "让科研回归本质，让工具服务于思想，让创造不被重复所困"

## Notes

- AI research assistant platform for researchers, graduate students, and faculty
- Supports all academic disciplines with emphasis on humanities & social sciences
- 3,000+ users from 985/211 universities; thousands of validated projects
- Product-Market Fit achieved; in formal launch and growth phase
- New users get a free usage quota on signup; pay-as-you-go credit top-ups available
- Sharing your invite code earns credit rewards with no cap
- Dozens of MCP connectors integrated and continuously expanding
- Covers frontier methods: spatial econometrics, advanced econometrics, bioinformatics, CAD analysis, Bayesian statistics, machine learning/AI, structural equation modeling, epidemiology
- Supports national competitions: Mathematical Modeling (CUMCM/MCM-ICM), Challenge Cup, Innovation & Entrepreneurship
- Official website: https://deepresvalue.top/

# docs/account/credits.en.md
# Credits System

DeepResValue uses a credits system to manage AI resource consumption. **New users receive a free usage quota upon registration** for immediate full-feature access. When your quota runs out, you can **top up credits on demand**. Using credits wisely maximizes your research output.

## Credit Consumption Rules

| Factor | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **File Size** | Larger uploaded files consume more credits |
| **File Count** | Multiple files in one session stack consumption; max 10 files per conversation |
| **Question Complexity** | More complex analysis (multi-step reasoning, multi-dimensional cross-analysis) consumes more |
| **Tool Calls** | Web searches, database queries, and other additional tool calls increase consumption |

## How to Earn Credits

| Method | Credits | Description |
|--------|---------|-------------|
| New User Registration | Free Quota | Receive a free usage quota upon registration |
| Top Up Credits | Pay-as-you-go | Top up credits on demand when your quota runs out |
| Invite Friends | +200 | Your invite code successfully used — **rewards have no cap** |
| Be Invited | +100 | Successfully register using someone else's invite code |

## Saving Credits

Effective methods to reduce credit consumption:

- Streamline files before upload — remove irrelevant columns, keep only observations needed for analysis
- State your full requirements in one message to avoid repeated questions causing duplicate consumption
- Max single file: 100MB; controlling data scope reasonably reduces consumption
- Merge similar data before uploading to reduce file count

## Checking Your Credits

1. **View balance** — The top-right corner of the top bar displays your current credit balance in real time.
2. **View consumption history** — Click the credit display area to view detailed consumption records.

> When credit balance is insufficient, new conversations cannot be sent. Monitor your balance and earn credits through friend invitations.

> **Auto-prompt on low credits**: When you attempt to send a message but have fewer than 1 credit, a purchase window appears automatically without interrupting or losing your current conversation.

> **Top bar color indicator**: Green when sufficient; orange warning at 1–5 credits; red "Insufficient Credits" at 0 — click to recharge anytime.


# docs/account/credits.zh.md
# 积分系统

深度研值采用积分制控制 AI 资源消耗。**新用户注册即享免费使用额度**，可立即体验完整功能。额度用尽后可**按需充值积分**继续使用。合理使用积分可以最大化你的科研产出。

## 积分消耗规则

| 维度 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 文件大小 | 上传的文件越大，消耗积分越多 |
| 文件数量 | 一次上传多个文件会叠加消耗，单次对话最多 10 个文件 |
| 问题复杂度 | 分析需求越复杂（多步骤推理、多维交叉分析），消耗越多 |
| 工具调用 | 涉及联网搜索、数据库查询等额外工具调用时，会增加消耗 |

## 积分获取方式

| 方式 | 积分数量 | 说明 |
|------|----------|------|
| 新用户注册 | 免费额度 | 注册即享免费使用额度，可立即体验完整功能 |
| 按需充值 | 按套餐 | 额度用尽后可按需充值积分继续使用 |
| 邀请好友 | +200 | 你的邀请码被他人成功注册使用，**邀请奖励不设上限** |
| 被邀请注册 | +100 | 使用他人邀请码注册成功 |

## 省积分技巧

> 以下方法可以有效降低积分消耗：
> - 上传前精简文件——去掉无关列、只保留分析需要的观测值
> - 一次把需求说清楚，避免反复追问导致重复消耗
> - 单文件上限 100MB，合理控制数据范围
> - 建议合并同类数据后再上传，减少文件数量

## 查看积分

1. **查看余额**
2. **查看消费记录**

> 积分余额不足时，新对话将无法发送，请及时关注余额并通过邀请好友等方式获取积分。

# docs/account/invites.en.md
# Invite & Earn

Invite friends to register on DeepResValue — both you and the invitee earn credit rewards for a win-win outcome. **Rewards have no cap** — the more you invite, the more you earn.

## Reward Rules

| Role | Reward | Description |
|------|--------|-------------|
| 🎁 **Inviter** | **+200 credits** | Credited automatically when your invite code is successfully used for registration |
| 🆕 **Invitee** | **+100 credits** | Automatically received as a new-user bonus after registering with an invite code |

## How to Invite

1. **Get your invite code** — Enter the user settings page and locate your unique invite code.
2. **Share the invite code** — Share it with lab members, classmates, or friends.
3. **Friend registers** — The invitee enters your invite code during registration.
4. **Credits arrive** — After successful registration, credits are automatically credited to both parties.

> Share with lab members and classmates — not only helping them overcome the entry barrier, but also earning generous credit rewards for yourself. There is no limit on the number of invitees.

## View Your Invite Code

The invite code can be found in the user settings page. Click the avatar area at the bottom of the sidebar to access settings.

> Each invite code can only be used when an invitee registers for the first time. Existing accounts cannot retroactively apply an invite code.

# docs/faq/index.en.md
# Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about using DeepResValue, organized by category.

## Registration & Login

### How do I register?

Visit [deepresvalue.top](https://deepresvalue.top), click "Get Access" or "Login" in the top-right corner. Register with your phone number and SMS verification code. New users automatically receive starter credits.

### Are conversation records saved permanently?

Yes. All conversations are stored in the cloud, linked to your account. Access them from any device after logging in. To delete, right-click a conversation in the sidebar and select "Delete" (irreversible).

## Feature Usage

### I can't code at all. Can I really use this?

Absolutely. DeepResValue is designed for "zero code." Just describe your analysis needs in Chinese — the AI handles everything from method selection to code writing to result output. The platform's core users are undergraduate students with no programming background.

### Are AI-generated results reliable? Can they be used in defense?

Yes. DeepResValue uses frontier LLMs, validated through thousands of real research projects. Most importantly, every analysis step preserves complete code and execution logs — when committee members challenge your methods, display the evidence chain directly. 100% reproducible.

### What if I don't have data?

The platform includes built-in city/provincial/county macro panels and listed company financial panels. Data collection skills also access financial markets, health, medical, biological, and literature external data sources. Describe your needs in Chinese and the AI returns structured data — no middlemen, no cost.

### What file formats are supported?

80+ formats across 11 categories: statistics/data (.csv, .xlsx, .dta, .sav, .parquet, etc.), documents (.pdf, .docx, .txt), images (.png, .jpg), archives (.zip, .rar), scripts (.py, .R, .do, .m), spatial data (.shp, .geojson), bioinformatics (.fasta, .vcf), and more. Max single file: **100MB**, max **10 files** per conversation.

### Is there a file size limit?

Max 100MB per file, max 10 files per conversation. For oversized files, consider splitting or compressing first.

### How many sessions can run simultaneously?

Maximum **2 concurrent sessions** per user. When 2 tasks are running, new submissions prompt a wait message. Wait for any task to finish, or right-click a running conversation in the sidebar to stop it and free a slot.

## AIGC Related

### AI traces are too obvious — what about AIGC detection?

DeepResValue includes a built-in AIGC detection reduction engine: 21 AI hot-word auto-replacement + Best-of-N rewriting + scene-aware humanization. Testing shows AIGC detection rates reduced from 85% to below the safe threshold.

## Usage Issues

### AI response was cut off — what do I do?

1. Refresh the page and reopen the conversation — in most cases, history is preserved.
2. If content was truly truncated, send "please continue" in the input box — the AI resumes from the breakpoint.
3. If problems persist, contact support via the "Help" entry at the bottom of the sidebar.

### Does the platform support team collaboration?

The current version does not support real-time multi-user collaboration. To share analysis results, export AI-generated content as PDF or Markdown and share with teammates.

## Credits

### Is there a free quota for new users?

Yes. New users receive a free usage quota upon registration for immediate full-feature access. When your quota runs out, you can top up credits on demand.

### Not enough credits?

You can get more credits through:

- **Top up on demand**: Recharge credits anytime when your quota runs out
- **Invite friends**: +200 credits per successful invite — **rewards have no cap**
- Register with an invite code: +100 new-user credits
- Watch for official events that may offer bonus credits

### How to save credits?

- Streamline files before upload — remove irrelevant columns, keep only needed observations
- State full requirements in one message to avoid repeated back-and-forth
- Reasonably control data scope and file count

## MCP External Connectors

### What are MCP connectors? Is there an extra charge?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) connectors let you call third-party professional data sources directly in conversation — such as PatSnap (patent & IP), PKULaw (legal search), Wind (financial data), iFinD (market data), Qichacha (business intelligence), and more — without leaving the platform. **Dozens of MCP connectors** are already integrated, covering patent/IP, legal, financial, business intelligence, academic literature, geolocation, survey, meeting, and quantitative data — **and continuously expanding**. **The platform charges no additional service fee** for MCP connectors; you only bear the third-party data source's own API costs (if any). Your tokens are encrypted and stored securely; you can disable or revoke access at any time.


# docs/faq/index.zh.md
# 常见问题

以下是深度研值用户最常遇到的问题，分类整理供你快速查阅。

## 注册与登录

### 如何注册账号？

访问平台官网 [deepresvalue.top](https://deepresvalue.top)，点击右上角「获取内测资格」或「登录」，支持手机号注册——填写手机号和短信验证码即可快速登录。首次注册后系统将自动赠送初始积分。

### 对话记录会永久保存吗？

是的，所有对话记录保存在云端，与账号绑定，换设备登录后仍可访问。如需删除，右键侧边栏对话选择「删除」（删除后不可恢复）。

## 功能使用

### 我不会编程，真的能用吗？

完全可以。深度研值的设计理念就是「零代码」。你只需要用中文说出分析需求，AI 自动完成选方法、写代码、跑分析、出图表的全过程。平台的核心用户就是不懂编程的本科生。

### AI 生成的结果可靠吗？答辩时能用吗？

可靠。深度研值搭载顶尖推理引擎，经数千个真实科研场景项目验证。最关键的是，每一步分析都保留完整代码和执行日志——答辩时评委质疑，直接展示证据链，100% 可复现。

### 没有数据怎么办？

平台预置城市/省份/县域宏观面板与上市公司面板数据，数据搜集技能还可接入金融行情、健康、医学、生物、文献等外部数据源。用中文一句话描述需求，AI 精准返回结构化数据，不用中介代查，不花一分钱。

### 支持哪些文件格式？

支持 30+ 种文件格式，包括：

| 类型 | 格式 |
|------|------|
| 数据文件 | .csv .xlsx .xls .dta .sav .zsav .tsv .json |
| 文档文件 | .pdf .doc .docx .txt .md |
| 图片文件 | .png .jpg .jpeg .gif .svg .webp |
| 压缩包 | .zip .rar .7z .tar.gz |
| 脚本/代码 | .py .R .do .Rmd .sql .sas .ipynb |
| 空间数据 | .shp .shx .dbf .prj .geojson .kml .gpx |
| CAD/工程 | .dxf .stl .obj .ply .glb .gltf .3mf .off .idf .epw .tcl |

单个文件最大支持 **100MB**，单次对话最多上传 **10 个文件**。

### 上传的文件有大小限制吗？

单个文件最大支持 100MB，单次对话最多上传 10 个文件。如需处理超大文件，建议先分割或压缩后再上传。

### 同时能运行几个会话？

每个用户最多支持 **2 个会话同时进行**。当已有 2 个任务正在运行时，提交新任务会提示已达上限。您需要等待任意一个任务完成，或在侧边栏右键对话选择停止后释放配额。

## AIGC 相关

### AI 的学术痕迹太重，会被查出 AIGC 怎么办？

深度研值内置降 AIGC 引擎：21 组 AI 热词自动替换 + Best-of-N 改写策略 + 场景感知优化。实测可将 AIGC 检测率从 85% 降至安全线以下。

## 使用问题

### AI 回复中断了怎么办？

可尝试以下步骤：

1. 刷新页面后重新打开该对话，大部分情况下历史结果已保存
2. 若内容确实截断，在输入框中发送「请继续」，AI 会从断点继续生成
3. 如反复出现问题，请通过侧边栏底部的「帮助」入口联系技术支持

### 平台支持团队协作吗？

当前版本暂不支持多人实时协作。如需共享分析结果，可将 AI 生成的内容导出为 PDF 或 Markdown 后分享给队友。

## 积分相关

### 新用户有免费额度吗？

有。新用户注册即享免费使用额度，可立即体验完整功能。额度用尽后可按需充值积分继续使用。

### 积分不够用怎么办？

> 您可以通过以下方式获取更多积分：
> - **按需充值**：额度用尽后可随时充值积分继续使用
> - **邀请好友**：每成功邀请一人获得 +200 积分，**邀请奖励不设上限**
> - 使用他人邀请码注册可获得 +100 新人积分
> - 关注后续官方活动，可能有额外积分赠送

### 如何节省积分？

- 上传前精简文件——去掉无关列、只保留分析需要的观测值
- 一次把需求说清楚，避免反复追问导致重复消耗
- 合理控制数据范围和文件数量

## MCP 外部连接器

### 外部连接器（MCP）是什么？使用要额外收费吗？

外部连接器（MCP）让你在对话中直接调用第三方专业数据源（如智慧芽 PatSnap、北大法宝、万得 Wind、同花顺 iFinD、企查查等），无需离开平台。平台已集成**数十个 MCP 连接器**，覆盖专利/IP/法律/金融/企业/学术文献/地理/调研/会议/行情等，且**持续扩张中**。**平台不额外收取 MCP 连接器的服务费**，你只需承担第三方数据源本身的调用费用（如有）。你的 Token 采用加密存储，可随时停用或解绑吊销。

# docs/features/academic-writing.en.md
# Academic Writing

DeepResValue covers every stage of paper writing — from topic selection to defense, full-cycle support.

## Covered Writing Stages

| Stage | What AI Helps With |
|-------|-------------------|
| **Topic Selection** | Evaluate topic feasibility, recommend frontier directions |
| **Proposal** | Auto-generate proposal framework, populate literature review |
| **Body Writing** | Polish paragraphs, optimize expression, check academic standards |
| **Data Analysis** | 100+ methods auto-matched, three-line tables + charts |
| **Format Check** | Auto-check reference formatting and layout standards |
| **Defense Prep** | Generate defense PPT outline, organize defense logic |

## Step-by-Step Usage

1. **Identify your writing stage** — Tell the AI which stage you are in (topic selection / proposal / body / format check / defense prep).
2. **Provide background information** — Describe your research topic, discipline, existing materials, and other context.
3. **Receive writing output** — The AI generates corresponding academic content based on your stage and needs.

## Example Prompts

> "Evaluate the feasibility of the topic 'The impact of digital inclusive finance on rural entrepreneurship' — analyze data availability and method choice."

> "Generate a proposal framework for my research on 'The impact of carbon emission trading on corporate green innovation'."

> "Academic-polish the following paragraph while maintaining scholarly style and improving logical coherence."

> "Help me organize my defense logic. My thesis is titled 'Research on the employment polarization effect of AI on the labor market'."

> In Academic Mode, AI output automatically conforms to academic standards including citation format, paragraph structure, and expression style.

> AI-generated academic content should be personalized before use to ensure it reflects your research characteristics and advisor's requirements.

# docs/features/aigc-detection.en.md
# AIGC Detection Reduction

DeepResValue's exclusive Chinese AIGC detection reduction engine helps solve the most anxiety-inducing issue before paper submission — AI trace detection.

## Core Technology

| Technique | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| **21 AI Hot-Word Auto-Replacement** | Automatically identifies and replaces high-frequency AI phrases such as "in today's era," "notably," "furthermore," etc. |
| **Best-of-N Rewriting** | Generates multiple rewritten versions per paragraph, automatically selects the optimal one |
| **Scene-Aware Humanization** | Adjusts rewriting style based on context (academic paper / competition report / coursework) |

## Step-by-Step Usage

1. **Input content to rewrite** — Paste the AI-generated paragraph or full text into the chat, or upload a document.
2. **Select the rewriting scene** — Tell the AI your use case (academic paper / competition report / coursework) for optimal style matching.
3. **Receive rewritten output** — The AI automatically performs AIGC reduction processing and outputs the rewritten content.

## Example Prompts

> "Perform AIGC detection reduction on the following paragraph. This is for an academic paper — maintain scholarly rigor while reducing AI detection rate."

> "Rewrite the third section of this literature review to remove obvious AI traces while preserving the original meaning."

> "Optimize the entire uploaded paper for AIGC reduction. This is a graduation thesis — language should be natural and conform to Chinese academic writing conventions."

> Measured results: AIGC detection rate reduced from **85%** to below the safe threshold. Academic Mode automatically enables AIGC reduction during writing.

> AIGC reduction is an auxiliary technique. For best results, add your personal insights and modifications on top of the AI output.

# docs/features/data-analysis.en.md
# Data Analysis

DeepResValue's most core capability — upload your data, describe your analysis needs in Chinese, and the AI handles the entire workflow from method selection to result output.

## How It Works

Upload your data (supporting Excel, CSV, PDF, Word, Stata, SAS, SQLite, and 80+ other formats), then describe your analysis needs in Chinese. The AI will:

1. Automatically understand your research intent
2. Match the optimal method from **100+ statistical and machine learning techniques**
3. Write Python or R code and execute it
4. Output journal-standard three-line tables, regression tables, and visualizations

## Supported Analysis Methods

| Category | Example Methods |
|----------|----------------|
| Advanced Econometrics | DID (Difference-in-Differences), IV (Instrumental Variables), GMM, RDD (Regression Discontinuity), Synthetic Control, Panel Fixed/Random Effects |
| Causal Machine Learning | DML (Double Machine Learning), Causal Forest, Meta-learner, Neural Causal |
| Bayesian Statistics | Bayesian inference, MCMC (Stan/PyMC), hierarchical Bayesian models, Bayesian networks, Bayesian optimization |
| Structural Equation & Psychometrics | SEM, Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA), scale reliability (Cronbach's α), IRT (Item Response Theory) |
| Epidemiology & Public Health | Cohort/case-control studies, meta-analysis, survival & competing risks (Cox/Fine-Gray), propensity score matching (PSM) |
| Statistical Tests | Descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, t-test, ANOVA, chi-square test |
| Machine Learning & AI | Random Forest, XGBoost, deep learning (CNN/RNN/Transformer), NLP text mining, model interpretability (SHAP/LIME) |
| Survival Analysis | Kaplan-Meier curves, Cox Proportional Hazards, Competing Risks (Fine-Gray) |
| Spatial Econometrics | Spatial Weight Matrices, Spatial Autocorrelation (Moran's I), SAR/SEM/SDM models, GWR |
| Bioinformatics | Genomics/transcriptomics/proteomics differential analysis, enrichment analysis (GO/KEGG), NGS sequencing data |
| Civil/Mechanical/Automation | Structural mechanics & FEA, mechanical simulation, control systems (PID/state-space), electronic circuits & PCB design, signal processing |
| Agriculture/Energy/Environment | Agricultural economics, energy econometrics & carbon emissions, carbon accounting, remote sensing & GIS, EKC analysis |
| CAD Analysis | Computer-aided design, engineering drafting, 3D modeling data |
| Text Analysis | BERT/LLM text classification, Sentiment Analysis, Topic Modeling |

## Step-by-Step Usage

1. **Upload your data file** — Click the attachment button to the left of the input box, or drag and drop files directly into the input area. Supports CSV, Excel, Stata (.dta), and 80+ other formats.
2. **Describe your analysis needs** — In the chat box, enter your specific analysis requirements in Chinese, including the method you want to use, variables to control, etc.
3. **View analysis results** — The AI executes the analysis automatically and generates three-line tables, regression tables, and visualization charts. All results can be downloaded from the right-side file panel.

## Example Prompts

> "Perform descriptive statistical analysis on the uploaded data, including mean, standard deviation, quantiles, and generate box plots."

> "Use DID to analyze the impact of digital transformation on corporate innovation, controlling for industry and year fixed effects, run parallel trend and placebo tests, output three-line tables."

> "Use Random Forest and XGBoost for classification prediction, output feature importance ranking and ROC curve."

> Average turnaround: from data upload to complete results, approximately **2 minutes**. All results are 100% reproducible with full code preservation.

> Tip: Before uploading, streamline your file — remove irrelevant columns and keep only the observations needed for analysis. This effectively reduces credit consumption.

# 数据分析

深度研值最核心的能力——上传数据文件，用中文描述分析需求，AI 自动完成从方法选择到结果输出的全过程。

## 工作原理

上传你的数据文件（支持 Excel、CSV、PDF、Word、Stata、SAS、SQLite 等 80+ 格式），用中文描述分析需求。AI 会：

1. 自动理解你的研究意图
2. 从 **100+ 统计与机器学习方法** 中匹配最优方案
3. 自动编写 Python 代码并执行
4. 输出期刊标准的三线表、回归表、可视化图表

## 支持的分析方法

| 类别 | 方法示例 |
|------|----------|
| 高级计量 | DID（双重差分）、IV（工具变量）、GMM、RDD（断点回归）、合成控制法、面板固定/随机效应 |
| 因果机器学习 | DML（Double Machine Learning）、因果森林、Meta-learner、Neural Causal |
| 贝叶斯统计 | 贝叶斯推断、MCMC（Stan/PyMC）、分层贝叶斯模型、贝叶斯网络、贝叶斯优化 |
| 结构方程与心理测量 | 结构方程模型 SEM、验证性因子分析 CFA、量表信效度（Cronbach's α）、IRT 项目反应理论 |
| 流行病学与公共卫生 | 队列/病例对照研究、Meta 分析、生存分析与竞争风险（Cox/Fine-Gray）、倾向评分匹配 PSM |
| 统计检验 | 描述统计、相关性分析、t 检验、方差分析、卡方检验 |
| 机器学习与 AI | 随机森林、XGBoost、深度学习（CNN/RNN/Transformer）、NLP 文本挖掘、模型可解释性（SHAP/LIME） |
| 生存分析 | Kaplan-Meier 曲线、Cox 比例风险、竞争风险模型（Fine-Gray） |
| 空间计量 | 空间权重矩阵、空间自相关（莫兰指数）、SAR/SEM/SDM 空间计量模型、地理加权回归 (GWR) |
| 生信分析 | 基因组/转录组/蛋白组差异分析、富集分析（GO/KEGG）、NGS 测序数据分析 |
| 土木/机械/自动化 | 结构力学与有限元分析、机械仿真、控制系统（PID/状态空间）、电子电路与 PCB 设计、信号处理 |
| 农业/能源/环境 | 农业经济学、能源计量与碳排放、碳核算与双碳研究、遥感与 GIS 空间分析、环境库兹涅茨曲线 |
| CAD 分析 | 计算机辅助设计、工程制图分析、三维建模数据处理 |
| 文本分析 | BERT/LLM 文本分类、情感分析、主题建模 |

## 使用步骤

1. **上传数据文件**
2. **描述分析需求**
3. **查看分析结果**

## 示例 Prompt

```text
请对上传的数据进行描述性统计分析，包括均值、标准差、分位数，并生成箱线图。
```

```text
用 DID 方法分析数字化转型对企业创新的影响，控制行业和年份固定效应，做平行趋势检验和安慰剂检验，输出三线表。
```

```text

```

> 平均耗时：从上传数据到出完整分析结果，约 **2 分钟**。数据分析功能支持 Python 代码执行，所有结果 100% 可复现。

> 建议上传前先精简文件——去掉无关列、只保留分析需要的观测值，可有效降低积分消耗。

# Data Sources

No data? No problem. DeepResValue's data acquisition capability operates on two levels: **built-in panel datasets** and **skill-driven data collection** from external sources. Describe your needs in Chinese and the AI automatically matches the appropriate data source.

The data engine directly reads authoritative Parquet files, covering six datasets:

| Dataset | Coverage |
|---------|----------|
| 📊 **City Macro Panel** | 2000–2023, 325 indicators including GDP, population, employment, industry, finance, trade |
| 🏙️ **Provincial Macro Panel** | 2000–2023, 2,468 indicators covering population, economy, education, employment |
| 🏘️ **County Panel** | 2000–2023, 61 indicators covering population, economy, education, health |
| 💼 **Listed Company Financials** | 2000–2023, 30 core financial indicators |
| 🏢 **Listed Company Governance** | 2000–2023, 84 indicators covering financials, governance, market data |
| 📍 **Industry & Geography** | 2000–2023, stock codes, industry classification, province location |

| Domain | Available Data |
|--------|---------------|
| 📈 **Financial Markets** | A-share/index/industry real-time and historical quotes; A-share/HK/US stocks, funds, bonds, macro EDB |
| 🏭 **Chinese Economic Data** | Province/city/county regional panels (1990–2024), listed company financials (5,822 companies / 857 indicators), firm geolocation, spatial boundaries |
| 🗺️ **Chinese Spatial Data** | Province/city/county administrative boundary GeoJSON, GB/T 2260 codes |
| 🏥 **US Health Data** | NHANES, BRFSS, NHIS, NVSS, WONDER (CDC public data) |
| ⚕️ **Medical Databases** | ClinicalTrials.gov, WHO Global Health, PubChem, MeSH/RxNorm, NCBI gene data |
| 🧬 **Biological Data** | EMBL-EBI databases, bioRxiv preprints |
| 📚 **Literature Search** | NCPSSD Chinese journals, CNKI enhanced abstracts, arXiv preprints, PubMed biomedical, Crossref metadata |
| 🌐 **Web Content** | Extract main text from specified URLs |

## MCP External Connectors

| Connector | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| **PatSnap (智慧芽)** ★ | Patent & IP | 34 official MCP services: patent search/analysis/valuation/landscape, clinical trials, drug assets, target-disease mapping, regulatory guidance, TRIZ engine, etc. |

| 📈 **金融行情** | 沪深 A 股/指数/行业/实时行情/历史行情；A 股/港股/美股/基金/债券/宏观 EDB |
| 🏭 **中国经济数据** | 省市县三级区域经济面板（1990-2024）、上市公司财务（5822 家/857 项指标）、企业地理定位、空间边界 |
| 🗺️ **中国空间数据** | 省市县行政区划边界 GeoJSON、GB/T 2260 行政区划代码 |
| 🏥 **美国健康数据** | NHANES、BRFSS、NHIS、NVSS、WONDER 等 CDC 公开数据 |
| ⚕️ **医学数据库** | ClinicalTrials.gov 临床试验、WHO 全球卫生指标、PubChem 化合物、MeSH/RxNorm 术语、NCBI 基因信息 |
| 🧬 **生物数据** | EMBL-EBI 生物数据库、bioRxiv 预印本 |
| 📚 **文献检索** | NCPSSD 中文期刊、CNKI 摘要增强、arXiv 英文预印本、PubMed 生物医学、Crossref 元数据 |
| 🌐 **网页正文** | 指定 URL 的网页正文内容提取 |

## MCP 外部连接器

平台已接入**数十个 MCP 连接器**，在对话中直接调用第三方专业数据源——无需离开平台、无需切换网页。AI 会自动判断是否需要调用连接器，你也可以主动触发。

| 连接器 | 类型 | 说明 |
|--------|------|------|
| **智慧芽 PatSnap** ★ | 专利与知识产权 | 官方 34 个 MCP 服务：专利检索/分析/估值/景观、临床试验、药物资产、靶点疾病、监管指南、TRIZ 引擎等 |
| **北大法宝** | 法律检索 | 中国法律法规、司法案例、学术期刊检索 |
| **万得 Wind** | 金融数据 | 上市公司财务、宏观经济、行业数据 |
| **同花顺 iFinD** | 金融行情 | A 股、公募基金、宏观数据、债券、财经新闻 |
| **企查查** | 企业信息 | 工商注册、风险信息、知识产权、经营数据、历史变更 |
| **百度 AI 学术搜索** | 学术检索 | AI 驱动的学术文献智能搜索 |
| **百度文库 / OCR** | 文档处理 | 文献图像识别、文档解析 |
| **开放学术四件套** | 学术元数据 | arXiv / PubMed / Crossref / Semantic Scholar（免认证） |
| **腾讯地图** | 地理服务 | 地理编码、POI 搜索、路线规划 |
| **腾讯问卷 / 会议** | 协作工具 | 问卷调研、会议纪要 |
| **TickDB** | 量化行情 | 外汇、贵金属、指数、美股/港股/A 股、加密货币量化数据 |

> 连接器持续扩展中。部分连接器（如北大法宝、万得 Wind）需要你填入自己的 API Token（BYOK），平台不额外收取服务费。

## 使用步骤

1. **描述数据需求**
2. **AI 自动匹配数据源**
3. **直接用于分析**

## 示例 Prompt

```text
帮我找 2015-2023 年地级市 GDP 和财政收入数据。
```

```text
获取某上市公司近 5 年的财务指标（营收、净利润、资产负债率）。
```

```text
查找 NHANES 调查中 2017-2020 年成年人的体重指数数据。
```

```text
检索近 3 年关于数字经济与碳排放的 PubMed 文献。
```

> 描述需求即可，AI 自动匹配数据源并返回结构化数据，**免费、免中介、免复杂查询**。

> 数据搜集能力持续扩展中，如需特殊领域数据，建议先在对话中描述需求，AI 会告知是否支持。

# docs/features/file-upload.en.md
# File Upload

DeepResValue supports **11 categories and 90+ file formats**, covering data needs across all academic disciplines. The AI can perform cross-file comprehensive analysis and comparison.

## Supported File Formats

| Type | Formats |
|------|---------|
| 📊 Statistics/Data | `.csv` `.xlsx` `.xls` `.dta` `.sav` `.zsav` `.tsv` `.json` `.sas7bdat` `.xpt` `.por` `.parquet` `.feather` |
| 🔬 Research Data | `.h5` `.hdf5` `.mat` `.RData` `.rds` `.nc` |
| 📄 Documents | `.pdf` `.doc` `.docx` `.txt` `.md` |
| 🖼️ Images | `.png` `.jpg` `.jpeg` `.gif` `.svg` `.webp` `.tif` `.tiff` |
| 📦 Archives | `.zip` `.rar` `.7z` `.tar.gz` |
| 💻 Scripts/Code | `.py` `.R` `.do` `.Rmd` `.sql` `.sas` `.ipynb` `.m` `.jl` `.nb` |
| 🌍 Spatial/Remote Sensing | `.shp` `.shx` `.dbf` `.prj` `.qpj` `.geojson` `.kml` `.gpx` `.gpkg` `.hdr` `.img` `.asc` `.dem` |
| 🧬 Bioinformatics | `.fasta` `.fastq` `.vcf` `.sam` `.bed` `.gff` `.pdb` `.cif` `.mol` `.sdf` |
| 📚 Bibliography | `.bib` `.ris` `.enw` |
| 📝 LaTeX Source | `.tex` `.cls` `.sty` `.bst` |
| 🏗️ CAD/Engineering | `.dxf` `.stl` `.obj` `.ply` `.glb` `.gltf` `.3mf` `.off` `.idf` `.epw` `.tcl` |

## Upload Steps

1. **Add files** — Click the **📎 attachment button** to the left of the input box, or **drag and drop** files directly into the input area.
2. **Confirm file tags** — After upload, file tags appear above the input box. Click **×** on a tag to remove that file.
3. **Send analysis request** — Enter your analysis needs and press Enter. The AI automatically reads and analyzes the uploaded files.

## Output Files

Files generated during AI analysis (reports, charts, code, etc.) appear in the **file panel to the right of the main chat area**:

- Click a filename to **preview** the content
- Click the **download** button to save locally
- Generated charts support zoom viewing and PNG download

### Supported Preview Formats

| File Type | Preview Method |
|-----------|---------------|
| PDF documents (.pdf) | Built-in PDF reader with zoom and page navigation |
| Office documents (.docx .xlsx .pptx) | Online preview preserving original formatting |
| Code & data (.csv .json .txt .py .R .md .do .sql .sas) | Syntax-highlighted code preview |
| Images (.png .jpg .svg .webp .tif) | Direct display with zoom support |
| Spatial data (.geojson) | Interactive map preview |

> You can upload multiple files at once; the AI performs cross-file comprehensive analysis and comparison. Maximum single file size: **100MB**.

> Maximum **10 files per conversation**. For oversized files, consider splitting or compressing before upload. Streamlining files before upload effectively reduces credit consumption.

## 产出文件

AI 在分析过程中生成的文件（报告、图表、代码等）会显示在 **主对话区右侧的文件面板** 中：

- 点击文件名可 **预览** 内容
- 点击 **下载** 按钮保存到本地
- 生成的图表支持放大查看和下载为 PNG 格式
> 支持一次上传多个文件，AI 可以跨文件综合分析与对比。单个文件最大支持 **100MB**。

> 单次对话最多上传 **10 个文件**。如需处理超大文件，建议先分割或压缩后再上传。上传前精简文件可有效降低积分消耗。

# docs/features/literature-review.en.md
# Literature Review

AI automatically searches Chinese and English literature, extracts key findings, and generates structured review reports.

## Features

- Automatically searches the latest research in relevant fields (NCPSSD Chinese journals, CNKI enhanced abstracts, arXiv English preprints, PubMed biomedical — four-source search)
- Classifies and organizes by topic, method, and conclusion
- Automatically cites source references
- Generates reference lists conforming to academic standards

## Step-by-Step Usage

1. **Describe the review topic** — State your research field, focus areas, and time range in the chat.
2. **AI conducts online search** — The AI automatically searches Chinese and English academic databases and screens relevant literature.
3. **Receive structured review** — The AI classifies literature by topic, method, and conclusion, producing a structured review report with all sources cited.

## Example Prompts

> "Write a literature review on digital economy and carbon emissions, citing recent 3-year core journals."

> "Search for the latest research on the relationship between corporate ESG performance and financial performance — 10 Chinese and 10 English papers, classified by conclusion."

> "Help me outline research progress on machine learning in medical image diagnosis, focusing on breakthroughs after 2022."

## Citation Traceability

Literature cited in AI responses is marked with superscript markers (e.g., `[1]`, `[2]`). Click to view full source details, ensuring academic citation accuracy and traceability.

> All citations are clickable for original source verification, making it easy to verify and cite.

2. **AI 联网检索**
3. **获取结构化综述**

# docs/features/reproducibility.en.md
# Analysis Traceability

DeepResValue is not a "black box AI" — every analysis step is **fully transparent and traceable**, 100% reproducible.

## Why It Matters

When defense committee members ask "How did you get this result?" — you can display the complete analysis path and code on the spot, proving the reliability of your results.

## What's Preserved

### Complete Code & Logs

After each analysis task, you can review:

- **Complete Python/R code**: Every line of code the AI executed is preserved
- **Execution logs**: Runtime status and intermediate results at each step
- **Data lineage**: The complete chain from input → cleaning → analysis → output

### Sub-Task Cards

Complex tasks are automatically decomposed into sub-tasks displayed as collapsible cards:

1. Each card shows the sub-task name (e.g., "Search related literature", "Execute data cleaning")
2. Click **▶ Expand** to view detailed process and results for that sub-task
3. After all sub-tasks complete, the AI aggregates and outputs the final conclusion

### Tool Call Visualization

During AI analysis, you can see in real time which tools it invokes:

| Panel | Displayed Content |
|-------|-------------------|
| **Search Panel** | Number of sources found and summaries during web search |
| **Code Execution Panel** | Code content, runtime status, and output during Python execution |
| **File Read Indicator** | Filename and parsing progress when reading uploaded files |

## Viewing the Analysis Process

1. **Send an analysis request** — Enter your analysis needs normally; the AI begins execution.
2. **Observe in real time** — During analysis, the interface shows tool calls, code execution, search results, and other intermediate steps in real time.
3. **Expand detailed logs** — After analysis completes, click each sub-task card to expand and view the complete code and execution logs.

> All analysis processes are permanently saved in conversation history, viewable at any time. During defense, you can directly display the complete evidence chain — 100% reproducible.

> If you need to include the analysis process as a thesis appendix, consider screenshotting the key code panels and execution results.


# docs/features/reproducibility.zh.md
# 分析溯源

深度研值不是「黑箱 AI」——每一步分析过程都 **完全透明、可追溯**，100% 可复现。

## 为什么重要

答辩时评委问你「这个结果怎么来的」——直接展示完整的分析路径和代码，当场证明结果的可靠性。

## 透明化内容

### 📋 完整代码与日志

每个分析任务完成后，你可以查看：

- **完整 Python 代码**：AI 执行的每一行代码都保留
- **执行日志**：每一步的运行状态、中间结果
- **数据追溯**：输入数据 → 清洗 → 分析 → 输出的完整链路
### 🧩 子任务卡片

复杂任务会被自动拆解为多个子任务，以折叠卡片形式展示：

1. 每张卡片显示子任务名称（如「搜索相关文献」「执行数据清洗」）
2. 点击 **▶ 展开** 查看该子任务的详细过程与结果
3. 所有子任务完成后，AI 汇总输出最终结论
### 🔧 工具调用可视化

在 AI 分析过程中，你可以实时看到它调用了哪些工具：

| 面板 | 展示内容 |
|------|----------|
| **搜索面板** | 联网搜索时显示检索到的来源数量和摘要 |
| **代码执行面板** | 执行 Python 代码时显示代码内容、运行状态和输出 |
| **文件读取提示** | 读取上传文件时显示文件名和解析进度 |
## 查看分析过程

1. **发送分析请求**
2. **观察实时过程**
3. **展开详细日志**

> 所有分析过程永久保存在对话记录中，随时可回看。答辩时可直接展示完整证据链，100% 可复现。

> 如需将分析过程作为论文附件，建议截图保存关键步骤的代码面板和执行结果。

# docs/features/skills.en.md
# Skills System

DeepResValue includes **100+ professional skills** covering the full research workflow. Skills have been **validated through thousands of real research projects** and are at the **global cutting edge**. Selecting a matching skill causes the AI to load domain-specific professional knowledge and analysis tools, significantly improving output quality. All research data is built-in — just state your needs and the Agent calls autonomously. All frontier research analysis methods are supported — no method is out of reach; the Agent writes code in real time guided by specialized skills and executes in the cloud.

## Skill Categories

| Category | Representative Skills | Use Cases |
|----------|---------------------|-----------|
| 🔬 Empirical Analysis | Python/R full-workflow empirical, panel analysis, spatial econometrics (SAR/SEM/SDM), time series, mediation-moderation, multilevel HLM, SEM | Quantitative research |
| 🤖 Causal Inference | Bayesian causal inference, ML-based causal, DID/RDD/IV/Synthetic Control, GMM, propensity score matching (PSM) | Frontier methodology |
| 📊 Bayesian Statistics | Bayesian inference, MCMC (Stan/PyMC), hierarchical Bayesian models, Bayesian networks, Bayesian optimization | Bayesian methods |
| 🧠 ML & AI | Deep learning (CNN/RNN/Transformer), NLP text mining, computer vision, model interpretability (SHAP/LIME), LLM research applications | AI × research |
| 🏥 Epidemiology | Cohort/case-control studies, meta-analysis, survival & competing risks (Cox/Fine-Gray), PSM, public health big data | Medicine & public health |
| 📚 Literature & Writing | Literature collection, literature review, scientific writing, academic polish, academic proofreading | Proposals, paper writing |
| 🏆 Competition Guidance | Statistical Modeling, Math Modeling, Challenge Cup (continuously updated) | Competition preparation |
| 📊 Data & Charts | Data cleaning, SciPlot scientific plotting, LaTeX academic typesetting | Everyday research |
| 🧬 Discipline-Specific | Bioinformatics (BioPython/scanpy — genomics/transcriptomics/proteomics, enrichment analysis), Materials Science (pymatgen), Chemoinformatics (RDKit), Quantum Computing (Qiskit), CAD/engineering drafting, finite element analysis | Specialized fields |
| 📋 Academic Workflow | Topic design, application writing, peer review response, poster/slides creation | Full academic cycle |
| 💻 Tool Ecosystem | Stata empirical methodology (generates do-files for local execution), Python ML (scikit-learn), network analysis (networkx), geospatial (geopandas), symbolic math (SymPy) | Toolchain support |
| 🔎 Data Collection | Financial markets, Chinese economic data, health data (CDC), medical databases, biological data (EMBL-EBI/bioRxiv), literature search (NCPSSD/CNKI/arXiv/PubMed) | Data acquisition |
| ⚙️ Engineering Computing | MATLAB script (.m) execution, SPICE circuit simulation, control systems (PID/state-space), signal processing | Automation/electronics/control |

## How Skills Work

Selecting a skill is equivalent to loading a **domain-specific knowledge base** for the AI:

- **Empirical Analysis skills**: The AI understands the applicable conditions of various econometric methods and hypothesis testing procedures
- **Competition skills**: The AI is familiar with competition scoring criteria and award-winning paper writing patterns
- **Discipline-specific skills**: The AI loads the corresponding discipline's professional tool library and terminology system

## Usage Steps

1. **Open the skill panel** — Find the skill selection entry in the conversation interface.
2. **Select the appropriate skill** — Browse and choose the most matching skill based on your research needs.
3. **Start the conversation** — After selecting a skill, enter your question normally. The AI provides more precise output based on the selected skill's knowledge base.

## Example Scenarios

> After selecting the "Full-Workflow Empirical Analysis" skill:
> "Use DID to analyze a policy effect — run parallel trend tests, placebo tests, and robustness checks."

> After selecting the "Professional Scientific Plotting" skill:
> "Draw a forest plot from regression results, mark 95% confidence intervals, export as 300dpi high-resolution PNG."

> Selecting a matching skill significantly improves output quality. Without selecting a skill, the AI still works but precision may be lower.

> The skill list is continuously updated. If you cannot find a perfect match, choose the closest one — the AI will adapt automatically.


# docs/features/skills.zh.md
# 技能系统

深度研值内置 **100+ 个专业技能**，覆盖科研全流程。技能经**数千真实科研项目实战检验**，达到**全球顶尖水平**。选择匹配的技能后，AI 将加载对应领域的专业知识与分析工具，输出质量更高。各类科研数据内置，只需说需求 Agent 自主调用。前沿科研分析方法全覆盖——没有做不了的科研分析方法，Agent 实时在专业 skills 指导下写代码、云端执行。

## 技能分类

| 技能类别 | 代表技能（部分） | 适用场景 |
|----------|------------------|----------|
| 🔬 实证分析 | Python 全流程实证分析、R 全流程实证分析、面板分析、空间计量（SAR/SEM/SDM）、时间序列、中介调节、多层HLM、结构方程模型 SEM | 各类量化研究 |
| 🤖 因果推断 | 贝叶斯因果推断、机器学习因果、DID/RDD/IV/合成控制、GMM、倾向评分匹配 PSM | 前沿方法论 |
| 📊 贝叶斯统计 | 贝叶斯推断、MCMC（Stan/PyMC）、分层贝叶斯模型、贝叶斯网络、贝叶斯优化 | 贝叶斯方法 |
| 🧠 机器学习与 AI | 深度学习（CNN/RNN/Transformer）、NLP 文本挖掘、计算机视觉、模型可解释性（SHAP/LIME）、大模型科研应用 | AI 交叉科研 |
| 🏥 流行病学 | 队列/病例对照研究、Meta 分析、生存分析（Cox/Fine-Gray）、PSM、公共卫生大数据 | 医学与公共卫生 |
| 📚 文献与写作 | 文献搜集、文献综述、科学写作、学术润色、学术校对 | 开题、论文写作 |
| 🏆 竞赛指导 | 统计建模大赛、挑战杯、三创赛（持续更新） | 竞赛冲刺 |
| 📊 数据与图表 | 数据清洗、专业科研绘图（SciPlot）、学术排版（LaTeX） | 日常科研 |
| 🧬 学科专项 | 生物信息学（BioPython/scanpy，基因组/转录组/蛋白组分析、富集分析）、材料科学（pymatgen）、化学信息学（RDKit）、量子计算（Qiskit）、CAD/工程制图分析、有限元分析 | 学科专用 |
| 📋 学术流程 | 选题设计、申请书撰写、同行评审回复、海报/幻灯片制作 | 学术全周期 |
| 💻 工具生态 | Stata 实证方法论（生成 do 文件供本地运行）、Python机器学习（scikit-learn）、网络分析（networkx）、地理空间（geopandas）、符号数学（SymPy） | 工具链支持 |
| 🔎 数据搜集 | 金融行情（HSData/Wind）、中国经济数据、健康数据（CDC）、医学数据库、生物数据（EMBL-EBI/bioRxiv）、文献检索（NCPSSD/CNKI/arXiv/PubMed） | 数据获取与选题准备 |
| ⚙️ 工科计算 | MATLAB 脚本（.m）执行、SPICE 电路仿真、控制系统（PID/状态空间）、信号处理 | 自动化/电子/控制类 |

## 使用步骤

1. **打开技能面板**
2. **选择合适的技能**
3. **开始对话**

## 技能如何工作

选择技能相当于为 AI 加载了一套 **专业领域知识库**：

- **实证分析技能**：AI 了解各类计量方法的适用条件、假设检验流程
- **竞赛技能**：AI 熟悉竞赛评分标准、获奖论文写作模式
- **学科专项技能**：AI 加载对应学科的专业工具库和术语体系

## 示例场景

```text
选择「全流程实证分析」技能后：
用 DID 方法分析政策效应，需要做平行趋势检验、安慰剂检验和稳健性检验。
```

```text
选择「专业科研绘图」技能后：
根据回归结果画森林图，标注 95% 置信区间，导出 300dpi 高清 PNG。
```

> 选择匹配的技能后，AI 将加载对应领域的专业知识与分析工具，输出质量显著提升。不选技能时 AI 也能工作，但精准度可能较低。

> 技能列表持续更新中，如果找不到完全匹配的技能，选择最接近的即可，AI 会自动适配。

# docs/features/typesetting.en.md
# Typesetting

DeepResValue includes built-in LaTeX and Word typesetting engines, **all cloud-pre-configured and ready to use** — no local TeX distribution or Office installation required. Open your browser and start typesetting immediately. Generates journal-standard professional charts and documents, ready to paste directly into your paper.

## Features

- **LaTeX typesetting engine** generates journal-standard professional charts
- **Multiple academic chart types**: three-line tables, regression tables, structural equation diagrams, event study plots — directly usable in papers
- **Multi-format export**: PDF / Word / LaTeX source, submission-ready formatting in one click
- **Professional scientific plotting**: Built-in DeepResValue-SciPlot skill covering 20+ academic chart types

## Supported Chart Types

| Category | Example Charts |
|----------|---------------|
| Statistical Charts | Scatter plots, heatmaps, box plots, violin plots |
| Academic Charts | Forest plots, funnel plots, event study plots |
| Structural Diagrams | Path analysis, structural equation models, social network graphs |
| Specialized Charts | Brain activation maps, gene expression heatmaps, geospatial maps |

## Step-by-Step Usage

1. **Complete data analysis** — First use the data analysis feature to run your statistical analysis, or directly upload content for typesetting.
2. **Specify typesetting needs** — Tell the AI the format you need (three-line table / regression table / specific journal format, etc.).
3. **Receive typeset output** — The AI uses the LaTeX engine to produce professional typeset results. Download as PDF, Word, or LaTeX source.

## Example Prompts

> "Output regression results as a three-line table with coefficients, standard errors, t-values, and significance stars."

> "Typeset this research report in LaTeX, following the submission format of Economic Research Journal."

> "Generate event study plots and parallel trend test plots conforming to academic publication standards."

> Built-in DeepResValue-SciPlot plotting skill covers scatter plots, heatmaps, forest plots, path analysis diagrams, social network graphs, and 20+ other academic chart types.

> Typesetting output requires some processing time. Complex documents may take tens of seconds.

# 欢迎来到深度研值

**DeepResValue（深度研值）** 是一款面向全学科科研工作者的 AI Super Agent 平台。无论你是本科生写课程论文、研究生做课题研究，还是博士生攻学位论文、教授做项目申报——深度研值都能提供专业级支持。
## 适用人群

- 📝 **本科生**：写课程论文、冲建模竞赛、赶毕业论文
- 📊 **研究生**：做课题研究、发期刊论文、准备开题/答辩
- 🎓 **博士生**：攻学位论文、做前沿方法探索
- 🔬 **教授/研究员**：做项目申报、带团队、写基金申请书

> 平台上线以来，已成功服务 3000+ 名 985/211 高校教授、硕博与学生用户完成科研任务，经数千个真实科研场景项目验证，分析方法覆盖经济学、管理学、生物医学、环境科学、社会科学等全学科领域。

## 核心理念

**权威 · 可靠 · 真实 · 易上手。**

## 为什么选择深度研值

### 🏛️ 权威引擎

搭载 **DeepSeek V4 Flash** 顶尖推理模型，具备百万级 Token 深度上下文理解能力。不是简单的聊天机器人——它能真正理解你的研究问题，自主选择最优分析方法，生成专业级结果。

### 🔍 完全可复现

每一步分析都保留 **完整 Python 代码与执行日志**。答辩时评委质疑"你怎么做的"？一键展示完整分析路径与证据链——无懈可击。

> 据多数用户反馈，这是他们答辩时最硬气的时刻。

### 📊 真实数据

平台预置城市/省份/县域宏观面板与上市公司面板数据，数据搜集技能持续接入金融、健康、医学、生物、文献等外部数据源。用中文一句话描述需求，AI 精准返回结构化数据，**免费、免中介、免复杂查询**。

### ⚡ 说中文就能用

不需要学 Stata、R、Python，不需要懂统计公式。用中文说出你的分析需求，AI 自动选方法、写代码、跑回归、出三线表。**注册即用，3 分钟上手**。

# docs/getting-started/interface-overview.en.md
# Interface Overview

After logging in, the main interface is divided into three areas. Understanding each area helps you use the platform more efficiently.

## Main Areas

| Area | Location | Primary Functions |
|------|----------|-------------------|
| **Left Sidebar** | Left side of screen | Conversation list, global search, folder management |
| **Main Chat Area** | Center of screen | Message input, AI response display, file panel |
| **Top Bar** | Top of screen | Current conversation title, credit balance, account settings |

## Left Sidebar

The sidebar is your central hub for managing all conversations:

- **New Conversation**: Click the "+ New Conversation" button at the top to start a fresh dialog
- **Conversation List**: Displays all past conversations; click any to switch
- **Search**: The search box at the top filters conversations by keyword in real time
- **Folder Management**: Group related conversations into folders for organization
- **Theme Switching**: The theme button on the left edge toggles between interface styles

## Main Chat Area

The main chat area is your core workspace:

- **Message Stream**: AI responses display incrementally via streaming
- **Input Box**: Located at the bottom, used for sending messages and uploading files
- **File Panel**: The right-side panel displays AI-generated files (reports, charts, code)
- **Tool Call Visualization**: Real-time display of AI-invoked tools — search, code execution, file reads

## Interface Themes

Five themes are available. Click the theme button on the left edge of the sidebar to switch:

| Theme | Style | Best For |
|-------|-------|----------|
| Follow System | Auto-matches OS theme | General use, automatic adaptation |
| Light | Neutral blue-white, clear and bright | Everyday use |
| Dark | Cool gray-blue dark background | Nighttime use |
| Solarized | Classic muted color scheme | Extended coding/reading |
| Warm | Beige warm tone, soft contrast | Extended reading, eye comfort |

## Conversation Management

### Folder Management

1. Click **"+"** at the top of the sidebar → **"New Folder"**
2. Name the folder (e.g., "2026 Thesis", "Carbon Emission Research")
3. Drag conversations into the corresponding folder

### Conversation Actions

Right-click any conversation in the sidebar:

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Pin** | Fix the conversation at the top of the list |
| **Rename** | Change the conversation title |
| **Delete** | Permanently delete the conversation (irreversible) |
| **Export** | Export conversation as Markdown or JSON |

> Up to **5 conversations** can be pinned simultaneously.

### Concurrent Session Limit

- Maximum **2 sessions** running at the same time, operating independently
- Exceeding the limit requires waiting for one task to finish, or stopping a running conversation to free a slot

> To free a slot, right-click a running conversation in the sidebar and send a stop command.

### Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| **Cmd/Ctrl + K** | Open command palette (globally available) |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + N** | New conversation |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + B** | Toggle left sidebar |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + ,** | Open settings |
| **Cmd/Ctrl + /** | View keyboard shortcuts |
| **Enter** | Send message from input box |


# docs/getting-started/interface-overview.zh.md
# 界面概览

登录后进入主界面，了解各区域的功能可以帮助你更高效地使用平台。
## 主要区域

| 区域 | 位置 | 主要功能 |
|------|------|----------|
| **左侧侧边栏** | 屏幕左侧 | 对话列表、全局搜索、文件夹管理 |
| **主对话区** | 屏幕中央 | 消息输入、AI 回复展示、文件面板 |
| **顶栏** | 屏幕顶部 | 当前对话标题、积分余额显示、账户设置 |

## 左侧侧边栏

侧边栏是你管理所有对话的中心：

- **新建对话**：点击顶部「+ 新对话」按钮创建新的对话
- **对话列表**：显示所有历史对话，点击即可切换
- **搜索功能**：顶部搜索框支持关键词实时过滤
- **文件夹管理**：将相关对话分组归类整理
- **主题切换**：左侧主题按钮可切换界面风格
## 主对话区

主对话区是核心工作区域：

- **消息流**：AI 回复以流式方式逐步展示
- **输入框**：底部输入框用于发送消息和上传文件
- **文件面板**：右侧面板展示 AI 生成的文件（报告、图表、代码）
- **工具调用可视化**：实时显示 AI 调用的搜索、代码执行等工具
## 界面主题

提供 **四种界面主题**，点击侧边栏左侧的主题按钮即可切换：

| 主题 | 风格 | 适用场景 |
|------|------|----------|
| 暖色 | 米色暖调，柔和对比 | 长时间阅读，护眼 |
| 深蓝暗调 | 经典暗色配色 | 低光环境 |
| 浅色 | 中性蓝白，清晰明亮 | 通用日常 |
| 暗色 | 冷灰蓝深色背景 | 夜间使用 |
## 对话管理

### 文件夹管理

1. 点击侧边栏顶部的 **「+」** → **「新建文件夹」**
2. 输入文件夹名称（如「2026 毕业论文」「碳排放研究项目」）
3. 将对话拖拽到对应文件夹进行归类

### 对话操作

右键点击侧边栏中的任意对话：

| 操作 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **置顶** | 将对话固定在列表最顶部 |
| **重命名** | 修改对话标题 |
| **删除** | 永久删除该对话（不可恢复） |

> 删除对话后不可恢复，请谨慎操作。所有对话记录保存在云端，与账号绑定，换设备登录后仍可访问。

### 并发会话限制

- 最多 **2 个会话同时进行**，互不干扰
- 超出限制时需等待任意一个任务完成，或停止正在运行的对话释放配额

> 如需开启新任务，可在侧边栏右键正在运行中的对话发送停止指令，即可释放一个配额。

# docs/getting-started/quick-start.en.md
# Quick Start

**Zero install, zero configuration** — all four compute kernels + Word/LaTeX typesetting engine are cloud-pre-configured. Open your browser for a full research environment. Works on phone, tablet, and desktop with one account. Get started with DeepResValue in just a few minutes.

## Register & Login

1. **Visit the platform** — Open your browser and go to [deepresvalue.top](https://deepresvalue.top).
2. **Create an account** — Click **"Get Access"** or **"Login"** in the top-right corner. Register with your phone number and SMS verification code.
3. **Enter the main interface** — After registration you are automatically redirected to the main workspace.

> New users receive complimentary starter credits upon registration, granting immediate access to all features.

## Create Your First Conversation

1. **Start a new conversation** — Click the **"+ New Conversation"** button at the top of the sidebar.
2. **Enter your question** — Type your question or task description in the input box at the bottom, then press **Enter**.
3. **View results** — The AI begins analysis automatically and returns results in a streaming fashion.

## Writing Effective Prompts

The more specific your prompt, the more precise the AI output.

| Quality | Example |
|---------|---------|
| ❌ Vague | "Help me do an analysis" |
| ✅ Specific | "Use DID to analyze the impact of digital transformation on corporate innovation, controlling for industry and year fixed effects, run parallel trend and placebo tests, output three-line tables" |

> Tip: Stating your full requirements in one message saves credits by avoiding repeated back-and-forth.

## Three Usage Modes

DeepResValue provides three modes you can switch between at any time:

### 🎓 Mentor Mode

Your 24/7 academic advisor. Lost on topic selection? Unsure about methodology? The AI guides you step by step through research design, recommends optimal methods, and assesses feasibility.

> Try asking: "Is this topic feasible?" / "Which is better for my data, DID or DML?"

### 📝 Academic Mode

Full-service paper workflow — from proposal to graduation thesis, from literature review to defense slides, all in one place. Built-in AIGC detection reduction engine ensures confident submission.

> Try asking: "Write a literature review on digital economy and carbon emissions, citing recent 3-year core journals"

### ⚡ Professional Mode

Stata-grade analysis, no coding required. Describe your analysis needs in Chinese — the AI automatically writes Python/R code, runs regressions, and generates publication-ready tables and charts.

> Try asking: "Use DID to analyze this panel data, run parallel trend tests, output three-line tables"


# docs/modes/academic.en.md
# Academic Mode

Academic Mode provides one-stop paper writing services from proposal to graduation thesis, covering the full research writing cycle.

## Who It's For

- Undergraduate, master's, and doctoral students writing graduation theses
- Researchers preparing journal paper submissions
- Students preparing proposals or defense materials
- Researchers needing literature review and academic writing assistance
- Participants in national competitions (Mathematical Modeling CUMCM/MCM-ICM, Challenge Cup, Innovation & Entrepreneurship, Statistical Modeling)
- Researchers needing frontier analysis methods (spatial econometrics, bioinformatics, Bayesian statistics, SEM, epidemiology, machine learning/AI, etc.)

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Literature Review Generation | AI auto-searches Chinese/English literature, extracts key findings, generates structured reviews |
| Proposal Writing | One-click proposal framework generation with populated literature review |
| Format Checking | Automatic verification of reference formatting and layout standards |
| Defense Slides | Generate defense PPT outline in 3 minutes, organize defense logic |
| AIGC Reduction Engine | Built-in 21 AI hot-word replacement + Best-of-N rewriting for confident submission |

## Core Capabilities

### Full-Cycle Paper Writing

| Stage | What AI Helps With |
|-------|-------------------|
| Topic Selection | Evaluate feasibility, recommend frontier directions |
| Proposal | Auto-generate proposal framework, populate literature review |
| Body Writing | Polish paragraphs, optimize expression, check academic standards |
| Data Analysis | 100+ methods auto-matched, three-line tables + charts |
| Format Check | Auto-check reference formatting and layout standards |
| Defense Prep | Generate defense PPT outline, organize defense logic |

### AIGC Reduction for Confident Submission

- **21 AI hot-word auto-replacement**: Identifies and replaces phrases like "in today's era," "notably," etc.
- **Best-of-N rewriting**: Multiple rewritten versions per paragraph, auto-selects optimal
- **Scene-aware humanization**: Adjusts rewriting style based on context

## Example Prompts

> "Write a literature review on digital economy and carbon emissions, citing recent 3-year core journals."

> "Generate a proposal framework for my research."

> "Reduce AIGC detection on this content."

## How to Switch

1. **Enter the conversation interface** — Find the mode selection entry in the input box area.
2. **Select Academic Mode** — Click the mode toggle button and choose "Academic Mode."
3. **Start the conversation** — Takes effect immediately. Enter your paper writing or literature needs.

> AIGC reduction testing shows detection rates reduced from 85% to below the safe threshold. Combining with manual polishing is recommended for optimal results.


# docs/modes/academic.zh.md
# 学术模式

学术模式提供从开题报告到毕业论文的一站式论文写作服务，覆盖科研写作全周期。

## 适用人群

- 正在撰写毕业论文的本硕博学生
- 需要发表期刊论文的研究者
- 准备开题报告或答辩材料的同学
- 需要文献综述和学术写作辅助的研究人员
- 参加国家级竞赛（数学建模 CUMCM/MCM-ICM、挑战杯、三创赛、统计建模）的参赛者
- 需要前沿分析方法支持（空间计量、生信分析、贝叶斯统计、结构方程模型、流行病学、机器学习/AI 等）的研究者

## 功能特点

| 特点 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 文献综述生成 | AI 自动检索中英文文献，提炼核心观点，生成结构化综述 |
| 开题报告 | 一键生成开题报告框架并填充文献综述 |
| 格式检查 | 自动检查参考文献格式、排版规范 |
| 答辩 PPT | 3 分钟生成答辩 PPT 大纲，梳理答辩逻辑 |
| 降 AIGC 引擎 | 内置 21 组 AI 热词替换 + Best-of-N 改写，论文安心提交 |

## 核心能力

### 论文写作全周期

| 阶段 | AI 能帮你做什么 |
|------|----------------|
| 选题阶段 | 评估选题可行性，推荐前沿方向 |
| 开题阶段 | 自动生成开题报告框架，填充文献综述 |
| 正文写作 | 润色段落、优化表达、自动检查学术规范 |
| 数据分析 | 50+ 方法自动匹配，出三线表 + 图表 |
| 格式检查 | 自动检查参考文献格式、排版规范 |
| 答辩准备 | 生成答辩 PPT 大纲，梳理答辩逻辑 |

### 降 AIGC 安心提交

- **21 组 AI 热词自动替换**：自动识别并替换「在当今时代」「值得注意的是」等 AI 高频用词
- **Best-of-N 改写策略**：为每段内容生成多个改写版本，自动选最优
- **场景感知 humanize**：根据上下文调整改写风格

> 试试这样问学术模式：
> - 「帮我写关于数字经济与碳排放的文献综述，引用近 3 年核心期刊」
> - 「帮我生成开题报告框架」
> - 「这段内容降 AIGC 处理一下」

## 如何切换

1. **进入对话界面**
2. **选择学术模式**
3. **开始对话**

> 降 AIGC 功能实测可将检测率从 85% 降至安全线以下，但建议结合人工润色以达到最佳效果。

# docs/modes/professional.en.md
# Professional Mode

Professional Mode lets you achieve Stata-grade data analysis in Chinese — no programming skills needed whatsoever. Just describe your needs and the full analysis workflow executes automatically.

## Who It's For

- Researchers conducting quantitative empirical analysis
- Students who don't know Stata/R/Python but need to run regressions
- Paper authors who need three-line tables, regression tables, and other standard outputs
- Research personnel with specific data analysis needs

## Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Natural Language Driven | Describe analysis needs in Chinese; AI auto-writes and executes code |
| 100+ Analysis Methods | Covers DID, IV, RDD, DML, Causal Forest, and other mainstream methods |
| Standardized Output | Journal-standard three-line tables, regression tables, visualizations |
| Full Code Preservation | Complete Python/R code and execution logs at every step |
| 100% Reproducible | Full analysis path displayable during defense |

## Supported Analysis Methods

| Category | Example Methods |
|----------|----------------|
| Traditional Econometrics | DID, IV, RDD, Synthetic Control, Panel Fixed Effects |
| Causal ML | DML, Causal Forest, Meta-learner |
| Statistical Tests | Descriptive stats, correlation, t-test, ANOVA, chi-square |
| Machine Learning | Random Forest, XGBoost, Neural Networks, Clustering, PCA |
| Survival Analysis | Kaplan-Meier, Cox Proportional Hazards, Competing Risks |
| Spatial Econometrics | Spatial Weight Matrix, Moran's I, GWR |
| Text Analysis | BERT/LLM classification, Sentiment Analysis, Topic Modeling |

## Example Prompts

> "Use DID to analyze this panel data, run parallel trend and placebo tests, output three-line tables."

> "Run descriptive statistics and correlation analysis on this data."

> "Use instrumental variables to address endogeneity — report the first-stage F-statistic."

## Analysis Workflow

1. **Upload data** — Supports Excel, CSV, Stata (.dta), SAS, SPSS, and 80+ formats. Max single file: 100MB.
2. **Describe needs** — State your analysis requirements in Chinese. The more specific, the better.
3. **AI auto-executes** — The AI automatically understands intent, selects methods, writes code, and performs analysis.
4. **Obtain results** — Outputs three-line tables, regression tables, and visualizations, ready for direct use in papers.

> Average turnaround: from data upload to complete results, approximately 2 minutes.

## How to Switch

1. **Enter the conversation interface** — Find the mode selection entry in the input box area.
2. **Select Professional Mode** — Click the mode toggle button and choose "Professional Mode."
3. **Start the conversation** — Takes effect immediately. Upload data files and enter analysis needs.

> Before uploading, streamline your data — remove irrelevant columns and keep only the observations needed for analysis. This effectively improves analysis speed and saves credits.


# docs/modes/professional.zh.md
# 专业模式

专业模式让你用中文实现 Stata 级别的数据分析——不会编程完全没关系，说出需求即可自动完成全流程分析。

## 适用人群

- 需要进行量化实证分析的研究者
- 不会 Stata/R/Python 但需要跑回归的同学
- 需要生成三线表、回归表等标准输出的论文作者
- 有明确数据分析需求的科研人员

## 功能特点

| 特点 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 自然语言驱动 | 用中文说出分析需求，AI 自动写代码执行 |
| 50+ 分析方法 | 覆盖 DID、IV、RDD、DML、因果森林等主流方法 |
| 标准化输出 | 生成期刊标准的三线表、回归表、可视化图表 |
| 完整代码保留 | 每一步分析保留完整 Python 代码与执行日志 |
| 100% 可复现 | 答辩时可直接展示完整分析路径 |

## 支持的分析方法

| 类别 | 方法示例 |
|------|----------|
| 传统计量 | DID（双重差分）、IV（工具变量）、RDD（断点回归）、合成控制法、面板固定效应 |
| 因果机器学习 | DML（Double Machine Learning）、因果森林、Meta-learner |
| 统计检验 | 描述统计、相关性分析、t 检验、方差分析、卡方检验 |
| 机器学习 | 随机森林、XGBoost、神经网络、聚类分析、主成分分析 |
| 生存分析 | Kaplan-Meier 曲线、Cox 比例风险、竞争风险模型 |
| 空间计量 | 空间权重矩阵、莫兰指数、地理加权回归 (GWR) |
| 文本分析 | BERT/LLM 文本分类、情感分析、主题建模 |

> 试试这样问专业模式：
> - 「用 DID 分析这个面板数据，做平行趋势检验和安慰剂检验，输出三线表」
> - 「对这份数据做描述统计和相关性分析」
> - 「用工具变量法解决内生性问题，第一阶段 F 统计量要报告」

## 分析流程

1. **上传数据**
2. **描述需求**
3. **AI 自动执行**
4. **获取结果**

> 平均耗时：从上传数据到出完整分析结果，约 2 分钟。

## 如何切换

1. **进入对话界面**
2. **选择专业模式**
3. **开始对话**

> 建议上传前精简数据——去掉无关列、只保留分析需要的观测值，可有效提高分析速度并节省积分。

# docs/product-intro.en.md
# DeepResValue — Product Introduction

> **Let science return to its essence. Let tools serve ideas. Let creativity be freed from repetition.**

---

## One-Line Summary

**DeepResValue** is an AI research assistant for researchers across all disciplines — **zero-install, zero-configuration: open your browser for a full-stack research environment**. Drive analysis with a single Chinese sentence, automatically write code, search literature, and typeset papers. Works on **phone, tablet, and desktop** with one unified account. All frontier research analysis methods are supported — no method is out of reach. The Agent writes code in real time guided by specialized skills and executes in the cloud.

---

## Research Pain Points & Solutions

| Pain Point | DeepResValue's Solution |
|------------|------------------------|
| 🔴 **Code & statistics barrier** | Natural-language-driven (Chinese) — AI auto-writes and executes code for DID, DML, RDD, and other frontier methods |
| 🔴 **Fragmented toolchain** | One-stop pipeline: Search → Analyze → Write → Typeset — no more switching between Stata, SPSS, Word, and LaTeX |
| 🔴 **Data acquisition difficulty** | 6 built-in panel datasets (city/provincial/county/listed-company) + 100+ skills for multi-source data collection |
| 🔴 **Non-reproducible analysis** | Full code and execution logs preserved at every step — 100% traceable and reproducible for defense presentations |
| 🔴 **Time-consuming typesetting** | Word + LaTeX professional typesetting engine **pre-configured in the cloud, ready to use** — export PDF/Word/LaTeX source with one click |
| 🔴 **Language & expression barrier** | Fully Chinese interface with built-in AIGC detection reduction engine for confident paper submission |
| 🔴 **Environment setup hassle** | Four compute kernels + typesetting engine all **cloud-pre-configured — zero install, zero setup** |
| 🔴 **Device lock-in** | **Phone, tablet, desktop — one account, synced data**, all with full capability |

---

## Core Capabilities

### Zero-Config Full-Stack Environment

All four compute kernels (Python / R / MATLAB-Octave / SPICE-ngspice) + Word / LaTeX typesetting engine are **pre-configured in the cloud**. No installation, no setup — open your browser and you have a full research environment. **Phone, tablet, desktop — one account, synced data, seamless switching**, all with full capability.

### Four Computing Kernels

| Kernel | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Python Execution** | Core analysis engine covering 100+ statistical and ML methods |
| **R Execution** | Supplementary statistical analysis with native R package support |
| **MATLAB Script Execution** | `.m` scripts executed via Octave compatibility for automation/electronics/control scenarios |
| **SPICE Circuit Simulation** | Circuit simulation via ngspice for electronics engineering coursework and competitions |

### Word + LaTeX Typesetting Engine

- LaTeX engine generates journal-standard professional charts (three-line tables, regression tables, SEM diagrams, etc.)
- Export **PDF / Word / LaTeX source** — meet submission format requirements instantly
- Built-in DeepResValue-SciPlot plotting skill covering 20+ academic chart types
- **Cloud-pre-configured, ready to use** — no local TeX distribution or Office installation needed

### MCP External Connectors

Call third-party professional data sources directly via Model Context Protocol — **dozens of connectors** already integrated **and continuously expanding**:

| Connector | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| **PatSnap (智慧芽)** ★ | Patent & IP | 34 official MCP services: patent search/analysis/valuation/landscape, clinical trials, drug assets, target-disease mapping, regulatory guidance, TRIZ innovation engine, and more |
| **PKULaw (北大法宝)** | Legal Search | Chinese laws, regulations, judicial cases, academic journals |
| **Wind (万得)** | Financial Data | Listed company financials, macroeconomic data, industry data |
| **iFinD (同花顺)** | Financial Markets | A-share, public funds, macro data, bonds, financial news |
| **Qichacha (企查查)** | Business Intelligence | Business registration, risk, IP, operations, historical data |
| **Baidu AI Academic** | Academic Search | AI-powered academic literature search |
| **Baidu Wenku / OCR** | Document Processing | Literature image recognition, document parsing |
| **Open Academic Suite** | Academic Metadata | arXiv, PubMed, Crossref, Semantic Scholar (no auth required) |
| **Tencent Maps** | Geolocation | Geocoding, POI search, route planning |
| **Tencent Survey / Meeting** | Collaboration | Survey research, meeting minutes |
| **TickDB** | Quantitative Data | Forex, precious metals, indices, US/HK/A-share, crypto quantitative data |

> Connectors are continuously expanding. Visit the "External Connectors" page on the platform for the full list.

### BYOK — Bring Your Own Key

Connect your own LLM API: DeepSeek, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The platform only charges base sandbox execution credits; model costs are borne by the user.

### Chinese-Driven + Rigorous & Traceable

- Fully Chinese interaction — just describe your analysis needs
- 100+ professional research skills auto-matched, **validated through thousands of real research projects**
- **All frontier research analysis methods supported** — no method is out of reach; Agent writes code in real time guided by specialized skills and executes in the cloud
- All research data built-in — just state your needs and the Agent calls autonomously
- Complete code and execution logs at every step, meeting academic standards

# docs/product-intro.zh.md
# DeepResValue 深度研值 — 产品介绍

> **让科研回归本质，让工具服务于思想，让创造不被重复所困。**

---

## 一句话简介

**DeepResValue（深度研值）** 是面向全学科科研工作者的 AI 科研助手——**零安装零配置，打开网页即得满配科研环境**，用中文一句话驱动，自动写码分析、检索文献、排版论文。手机、平板、电脑三端互通，随时随地开展科研。前沿科研分析方法全覆盖，没有做不了的科研分析方法——Agent 实时在专业 skills 指导下写代码、云端执行。

---

## 科研群体痛点与解决方案

| 痛点 | 深度研值的方案 |
|------|---------------|
| 🔴 **代码与统计门槛高** | 中文一句话驱动，AI 自动写码执行——零编程即可完成 DID、DML、RDD 等前沿方法分析 |
| 🔴 **工具链割裂** | 一站式完成检索 → 分析 → 写作 → 排版，无需在 Stata、SPSS、Word、LaTeX 之间反复切换 |
| 🔴 **数据获取难** | 预置 6 套面板数据（城市/省级/县域/上市公司）+ 100+ 技能驱动多源数据搜集 |
| 🔴 **分析不可复现** | 全程保留完整代码与执行日志，100% 可追溯可复现，答辩时直接展示证据链 |
| 🔴 **排版耗时费力** | Word + LaTeX 专业排版引擎**云端预配置开箱即用**，一键导出 PDF/Word/LaTeX 源码，投稿格式快速达标 |
| 🔴 **语言与表达门槛** | 全中文交互界面，内置降 AIGC 检测率引擎，论文安心提交 |
| 🔴 **环境配置繁琐** | 四大计算内核 + 排版引擎全部云端预配置，**零安装零配置**，打开网页即用 |
| 🔴 **设备受限** | **手机、平板、电脑三端统一账号、数据互通**，均具备满配能力，随时随地科研 |

---

## 核心能力

### 零配置满配环境

四大计算内核（Python / R / MATLAB-Octave / SPICE-ngspice）+ Word / LaTeX 排版引擎全部**云端预配置**，用户无需任何安装配置，打开网页应用即得满配环境。**手机、平板、电脑三端统一账号、数据互通、随意切换**，均具备满配能力。

### 四大计算内核

| 内核 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| **Python 执行内核** | 核心分析引擎，覆盖 100+ 统计与机器学习方法 |
| **R 执行内核** | 补充统计分析能力，支持 R 原生包调用 |
| **MATLAB 脚本执行** | `.m` 脚本经 Octave 兼容执行，覆盖自动化/电子/控制类场景 |
| **SPICE 电路仿真** | 经 ngspice 执行电路仿真，支持电子工程类课程与竞赛 |

### Word + LaTeX 排版引擎

- LaTeX 排版引擎生成期刊标准专业图表（三线表、回归表、结构方程图等）
- 支持导出 **PDF / Word / LaTeX 源码**，投稿格式一键达标
- 内置 DeepResValue-SciPlot 绘图技能，覆盖 20+ 学术图表类型
- **云端预配置，开箱即用**——无需本地安装 TeX 发行版或 Office

### MCP 外部连接器

通过 Model Context Protocol 直接调用第三方专业数据源——**已集成数十个 MCP 连接器，且持续扩张中**：

| 连接器 | 类型 | 说明 |
|--------|------|------|
| **智慧芽 PatSnap** ★ | 专利与知识产权 | 官方 34 个 MCP 服务：专利检索/分析/估值/景观、临床试验、药物资产、靶点疾病、监管指南、TRIZ 创新引擎等 |
| **北大法宝** | 法律检索 | 中国法律法规、司法案例、学术期刊检索 |
| **万得 Wind** | 金融数据 | 上市公司财务、宏观经济、行业数据 |
| **同花顺 iFinD** | 金融行情 | A 股、公募基金、宏观数据、债券、财经新闻 |
| **企查查** | 企业信息 | 工商注册、风险信息、知识产权、经营数据、历史变更 |
| **百度 AI 学术搜索** | 学术检索 | AI 驱动的学术文献智能搜索 |
| **百度文库 / OCR** | 文档处理 | 文献图像识别、文档解析 |
| **开放学术四件套** | 学术元数据 | arXiv / PubMed / Crossref / Semantic Scholar（免认证） |
| **腾讯地图** | 地理服务 | 地理编码、POI 搜索、路线规划 |
| **腾讯问卷 / 会议** | 协作工具 | 问卷调研、会议纪要 |
| **TickDB** | 量化行情 | 外汇、贵金属、指数、美股/港股/A 股、加密货币量化数据 |

> 连接器持续扩展中，平台首页「外部连接器」页面可查看完整列表。

### BYOK 自接 LLM

支持 Bring Your Own Key，接入 DeepSeek、OpenAI 或任何 OpenAI 兼容 API。平台仅收取沙箱执行基础积分，模型费用由用户自行承担。

### 中文驱动 + 严谨可溯源

- 全中文交互，说出分析需求即可自动完成全流程
- 100+ 专业科研技能自动匹配，**经数千真实科研项目实战检验**
- **前沿科研分析方法全覆盖**——没有做不了的科研分析方法，Agent 实时在专业 skills 指导下写代码、云端执行
- 各类科研数据内置，只需说需求 Agent 自主调用
- 每一步分析保留完整代码与执行日志，满足学术规范要求

## 支持的学科场景

| 领域 | 能力示例 |
|------|----------|
| **经济学** | DID 双重差分、IV 工具变量、GMM、RDD 断点回归、合成控制法、面板固定/随机效应 |
| **管理学与营销** | 结构方程模型 SEM、量表信效度（Cronbach's α / CFA）、中介调节效应、多层 HLM、实验设计（RCT/准实验）、营销计量 |
| **心理学与教育学** | IRT 项目反应理论、行为实验与方差分析、教育评估与学习分析、语料库语言学、文本情感分析 |
| **生物医学** | 生存分析（Kaplan-Meier、Cox）、临床试验数据、PubMed 文献检索 |
| **流行病学与公共卫生** | 队列/病例对照研究、Meta 分析、竞争风险模型（Cox/Fine-Gray）、倾向评分匹配 PSM、公共卫生大数据 |
| **生信分析** | 基因组/转录组/蛋白组差异分析、富集分析（GO/KEGG）、NGS 测序数据分析 |
| **贝叶斯统计** | 贝叶斯推断、MCMC（Stan/PyMC）、分层贝叶斯模型、贝叶斯网络、贝叶斯优化 |
| **机器学习与 AI** | 深度学习（CNN/RNN/Transformer）、NLP 文本挖掘、计算机视觉、模型可解释性（SHAP/LIME）、大模型科研应用 |
| **环境科学与能源** | 空间计量（SAR/SEM/SDM、莫兰指数、GWR）、碳排放面板、碳核算与双碳研究、环境库兹涅茨曲线 |
| **空间地理** | 空间权重矩阵、空间自相关、GeoJSON 行政区划、遥感与 GIS 空间分析、地图可视化 |
| **社会科学** | 质性编码辅助、问卷数据分析、社会网络图、文本情感分析 |
| **健康医学** | NHANES/BRFSS 等 CDC 公开数据、MeSH 术语、NCBI 基因信息 |
| **人文社科** | 文献综述生成、学术写作润色、降 AIGC 检测率、论文全流程辅助 |
| **土木/机械/自动化** | 结构力学与有限元分析、机械仿真、控制系统（PID/状态空间）、电子电路与 PCB 设计、信号处理 |
| **农业科学** | 农业经济学、遥感与 GIS 空间分析、环境与资源经济分析 |
| **工科计算** | MATLAB 脚本执行、SPICE 电路仿真、CAD/工程文件分析、计算机辅助设计 |
| **数学建模** | 全国大学生数学建模竞赛（CUMCM）、美国大学生数学建模竞赛（MCM/ICM）全流程辅助 |
| **挑战杯** | 「挑战杯」全国大学生课外学术科技作品竞赛 / 创业计划竞赛，选题论证到报告撰写 |
| **三创赛** | 全国大学生电子商务"创新、创意及创业"挑战赛，创新立项→商业策划→路演答辩 |

> 以上均为平台已验证的真实能力，持续扩展中。
